_about: Registered how-to-vote cards, 2026 Victorian election: for each district the Labor card, the Liberal and/or National card and One Nation's statewide card, as a preference order (candidate names as on the ballot) or open:true where the card numbers only its own candidate. One card per party per district, read from the VEC's register as listed on 16 November 2026 (cards registered 10-13 November; registration runs to 20 November). Read from each PDF's text layer; the twelve Nationals cards draw their numbers as artwork and were read by eye. No Liberal card was registered for Williamstown. Scripts in .build/vic/model-2026/htv (PDFs not kept).
